composition: Uneven Doric columns of the Heraion, Kronos Hill behind · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: In the Altis, the Temple of Hera is a roofless row of standing Doric columns of uneven age and girth. Wooded Kronos Hill rises behind them. The Temple of Zeus is not rebuilt here; it remains a low footprint nearby rather than a second complete temple. The night is mainly clear, about 14.1°C, and the sanctuary is in moonlight only.
